preregistered.coin_dropout: D = misassignment of a prepared selector 1 with the coin prepared 1 minus with the coin prepared 0: large when D >= 0.036 - 3.0 se and D >= 3.0 se; small when |D| + 3.0 se < 0.012 for a prepared selector 0 and for a prepared selector 1
preregistered.control: b0 raw selector contrast above 3.0 standard errors, else the offset is absent and nothing about its mechanism is decided
preregistered.decision: the combination of the control, six_cz, coin_dropout and q12_correlation classes read from DECISIONS; every other combination is unresolved
preregistered.q12_correlation: G = misassignment of the selector with q12 prepared 0 minus with q12 prepared 1, the larger of the values at a prepared selector 0 and 1: large when G >= 0.036 - 3.0 se and G >= 3.0 se; small when |G| + 3.0 se < 0.012 at both prepared selector values
preregistered.qx: every template within twice the sampling floor of its ideal law
preregistered.six_cz: inverse-variance mean s of the raw selector contrasts of k4, k8 and k12 with b0's contrast s0: zero when |s| within 3.0 se of 0 and (s - s0) beyond 3.0 combined se, b0-like when (s - s0) within 3.0 combined se and |s| beyond 3.0 se, else unresolved
